title: Renoir - Act 2 & 3 Boss Guide (Location, Weakness & How to Beat)
description: Renoir in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it. Act 2 & 3, Old Lumiere / The Monolith.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Renoir is a recurring antagonist and one of the few bosses with no elemental weakness at all. You fight him more than once - first as the White-Haired Man, then at the end of The Monolith, and finally in the endgame - and each version adds tools rather than changing the fundamentals.

sections.title: Where to Find the Renoir
sections.content: Location: first encountered as the White-Haired Man after the Lampmaster fight in Act 1; the full fight is at the end of The Monolith in Act 2, and again in Lumiere in Act 3. This page covers the Monolith encounter.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:

Weak toNone

No weaknesses and no meaningful resistances - there is nothing to build around. Progress here comes from party quality and dodge/parry timing, not from matching an element.

sections.title: How to Beat the Renoir
sections.content:
There is no elemental answer

Renoir is the point in the game where elemental matching stops carrying you. Bring your best general-purpose party and your best upgrade levels; the fight is a mechanics check.

Two stages

The Monolith version has two stages, and the second brings a bestial lion form that fights alongside him. That phase adds fast jumping attacks and Gradient Attacks to the move list, so the second half is materially harder than the first.

The endgame version escalates

His final fight adds a Black Hole attack, a Void Cross and Void Meteors, and he can channel the Axons you already defeated - Sirene restoring his health, Visages granting him shields. If Visages is still standing in your save you are giving him free defensive layers.

  • No weakness - bring raw damage and defensive comfort.
  • Expect a second stage with an added lion summon.
  • Defeat the Axons before the final fight or he channels them against you.
